environment.description: Same EC2 instance (m5.large, Amazon Linux 2) running identical binary, but deployed within an EKS pod (namespace: legacy-orders) with Istio 1.19 sidecar injection enabled. The Envoy sidecar intercepts all inbound traffic on port 8080 via iptables REDIRECT rules (istio-init container). An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied with spec.action=DENY matching source.namespaces not in [legacy-orders], combined with a second AuthorizationPolicy with spec.action=ALLOW requiring request.headers[x-session-token] to be present (notValues: ['']). The DENY policy uses a 'rules[0].from[0].source.notNamespaces: [legacy-orders]' selector. The ALLOW policy has a 'rules[0].when[0].key: request.headers[x-session-token]' condition with 'notValues: [""]'. Both policies target workload selector app=order-service. The Envoy sidecar returns 403 RBAC_ACCESS_DENIED before the request reaches the application container if either: (a) the source is from a different namespace, or (b) the x-session-token header is missing/empty.

config.iptables_redirect: istio-init container redirects all inbound TCP to envoy on 15006
